=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py
  Line or code reference: 389-416, function test_render_prompt_py_prepends_phase_c_persona_prefix_without_altering_legacy_body
  Problem: The PR removed `apply_phase_c_persona_prefix()`, `_persona_prefix_enabled()`, `PHASE_C_PERSONA_PREFIXES`, and `FALSEY_ENV_VALUES` from `scripts/render_prompt.py` plus the call to `apply_phase_c_persona_prefix()` in `main()`. The test at line 389 iterates every mode, sets `PROMPT_PERSONA_PREFIX_ENABLED=true`, and asserts `persona_proc.stdout != legacy_proc.stdout` (line 404). Since the persona prefix code no longer exists in `render_prompt.py`, both renders produce identical output and the assertion fails.
  Why it fails at runtime: This test runs in CI at `.github/workflows/ci.yml:399`. Verified by running both paths: `persona.stdout != legacy.stdout` is now `False` — the assertion will fail deterministically on every CI run.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/render_prompt.py
  Line or code reference: lines 24-89 (removed `FALSEY_ENV_VALUES`, `PHASE_C_PERSONA_PREFIXES`), lines 589-594 (removed `_persona_prefix_enabled()` and `apply_phase_c_persona_prefix()`), line 776 (removed `prompt_text = apply_phase_c_persona_prefix(...)` call)
  Problem: The PR removed 98 lines of Phase C persona-prefix code from `scripts/render_prompt.py` — code that is unrelated to the Phase E plan-diagrams feature. This is scope creep: the linked issue says "Implement Phase E only" and "Stay inside `files_touched`".
  Why it fails at runtime: The immediate CI failure is covered above. Beyond that, if any operator has `PROMPT_PERSONA_PREFIX_ENABLED=true` set as a repo variable, the persona prefixes will silently stop being prepended to rendered prompts across all 18 modes, altering model guidance without notice.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py
  Line or code reference: 419-434, function test_render_prompt_py_treats_blank_persona_env_value_as_disabled
  Problem: This test also exercises `PROMPT_PERSONA_PREFIX_ENABLED` env-var handling. It asserts `blank_proc.stdout == legacy_proc.stdout` (line 431), which will still pass since both renders are now identical, but the test is now a tautology — it no longer validates any meaningful behavior and should be cleaned up as dead test code alongside the BLOCKER fix.
  Why it fails at runtime: Not a runtime failure per se, but dead test code misleads future maintainers into thinking persona-prefix behavior is still tested.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "Implement Phase E only. Enrich `prompts/mode-plan.txt` with optional `Data flow:`, `State machines:`, and `Failure modes:` sections plus the guard that trivial plans must stay terse. [...] Stay inside `files_touched`."
  Expected change site: Only `prompts/mode-plan.txt`, `.github/workflows/plan.yml`, `prompts/contracts/mode-plan.yml`, `agents.md`, a new test file, and CI wiring — not `scripts/render_prompt.py`.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff for `scripts/render_prompt.py` contains 98 lines removed and only 1 line added (call-site deletion). None of these removals relate to plan diagrams, data flow, state machines, or failure modes. They remove the Phase C persona-prefix system (`FALSEY_ENV_VALUES`, `PHASE_C_PERSONA_PREFIXES`, `_persona_prefix_enabled`, `apply_phase_c_persona_prefix`, and the `main()` call site). This is unrelated scope creep that breaks an existing CI test.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
